## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juan **Japanese Tang-pilgrim importation catalog** by **Shūei** 宗叡 (Japanese **Shūei**, **809–884**), the **last** of the *nittō hakke* — Tang-pilgrim Japanese monks. Shūei traveled to Tang in **862–865**, returning with the final substantial Heian importation of Tang Buddhist materials. Preserved at T55 no. 2174A. *notBefore* = **865**, *notAfter* = **865**.
